newsitem.title: USA: US Industries sees meeting EPS growth goal.
newsitem.headline: US Industries sees meeting EPS growth goal.

text.p: U.S. Industries Inc said Tuesday it expects to be in a position to meet its goal of achieving average annual earnings-per-share growth of at least 15 percent.
For the fiscal year ended September 30, the company reported net income of $133 million, or $2.54 per share, compared to a net loss in the prior year of $89 million, or $1.84 per share.

In the past year, U.S. Industries has sold its Blue Mountain Industries, Office Group America, Farberware, Spartus Electronics Corp, Piedmont Moulding Corp, Universal Gym Equipment, Jade Holdings and Franklin Dyed Yarns.

"With a more focused U.S. Industries, we maintain our optimism about the future," Chairman and Chief Executive David Clarke said in a statement. "While it is early in our fiscal year we believe we are in an excellent position to again meet our long-term goal of achieving average annual earnings-per-share growth of at least 15 percent."
